svg.aria-label: Parameter bifurcation and degree drop in polynomial families
svg.title: Parameter bifurcation and degree drop in polynomial families
svg.desc: Bifurcation map of F_a(x) = x(x+2)[(a-1)x^2 + (a+2)] as parameter a varies across real values.

g.text: 1 · Parameter line a ∈ ℝ for F_a(x) = x(x+2)[(a-1)x² + (a+2)]
2 · At a = 1: Degree drops from 4 to 2
Leading coefficient (a - 1) = 0. F₁(x) = 3x(x + 2). Exactly two distinct zeros: 0 and -2.
3 · At a = -2: Quadratic factor collapses to -3x² (Triple zero at 0)
F₋₂(x) = -3x³(x + 2). Two distinct real zeros: 0 (multiplicity 3) and -2 (multiplicity 1).
4 · At a = 2/5: Root coincidence with -2 (Double zero at -2)
x² = (a+2)/(1-a) = 4 ⇒ x = ±2. Negative root coincides with -2: roots are 0 (mult 1), 2 (mult 1), -2 (mult 2).
General intervals: 4 distinct real zeros for a ∈ (-2, 1) \ {2/5}; 2 distinct zeros elsewhere.
